transport: MCP Streamable HTTP over HTTPS, JSON-RPC 2.0

decision.label: MCP подходит с ограничениями
decision.reason: Анонимные Generic-цены и характеристики воспроизводимы, но StoreBound/AddressBound не подтверждены, OAuth-сессия отсутствует, презервативы и настоящий алкоголь не найдены.

oauth.redirect_uri_rules: Unverified until the user logs in and completes the registration form

capabilities.basis: 30 real observations collected across 10 queries; responses report personalized=false.
ID 36296 returned a detailed product record in two fresh sessions.
Numeric current prices, currency, and for some items old/discount data were returned.
30/30 sample rows normalized using title amount, MCP weight, or explicit per-kg unit; basis is stored.
Category paths and facets.categories are returned by search; no single complete tree endpoint was proven.
Search exposes page, limit, total, pages and has_more; limit schema maximum is 10.
Discount tool returned 854 anonymous results, page size 10, with current/old/discount fields.
Repeated ID 36296 and price matched today; long-term stability is not guaranteed.
Official page shop_id=5047141 identifies Marshal Vasilevskogo 17.
Directory and filter dictionaries were returned, but tested city/subway filter arguments did not change total or first page.
Anonymous product responses contain neither store context nor availability; 5047141 was not mapped to an MCP ID.
Official instructions require OAuth plus a saved delivery address; no authorized session was created.
Discovery metadata works, but client registration and user consent are required.
Anonymous searches for презервативы, Contex and Durex each returned total=0.
Alcohol-oriented searches returned only non-alcoholic or unrelated products; no genuine alcohol result was accepted.
Generic public prices are repeatable and automatable; geographic and personalized-price reproducibility remains unverified.
Client distinguishes HTTP 429 and respects limit<=10; actual threshold was intentionally not stress-tested.
